mainEntity.name: Why does client rights matter at the rights stage?

acceptedAnswer.text: It matters because defense and rights issues require calm, precise handling because the wrong response can affect status, deadlines, and later options. Before the next step, client rights usually has to be checked for delay, inconsistency, and procedural risk as much as for the legal rule itself.
